caption:
She rode an orca into a shark's jaws.
Seedance 2.0 handled the whole ocean battle.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 15 seconds, 16:9 landscape. Look: photoreal blockbuster underwater VFX, deep ocean blues and teals, god rays slanting down from the surface, floating particles and bubbles, anamorphic lens feel with blue lens flares, high contrast, cool teal color grade. Camera feel: big cinematic underwater camerawork: a wide side tracking shot, low-angle orbits, a locked side profile for the stand-off, and a shaking impact shot. Pacing: fast and building for 6 seconds, a tense 4-second charge, a blinding energy blast, then a calm, heroic final hold. No blood, no gore, no on-screen text, no logos.

CHARACTERS:
- THE SEA WARDEN: a woman in her early 30s with deep brown skin, a strong jaw and fierce focused expression, athletic muscular build. Long platinum-white locs that float and stream behind her in the water. Armor: a sleek form-fitting bodysuit of overlapping pearl-white and deep indigo shell plates, a single coral-red armored pauldron on her right shoulder, indigo bracers and greaves. Weapon: a tall bone-white trident with a spiral-carved shaft and three long barbed prongs that glow ice-blue when charged. Signature in every shot: the floating white locs and the coral-red pauldron.
- THE ORCA: a massive killer whale, glossy black with white belly and the white eye patches, a tall dorsal fin; she rides standing on its back just behind the blowhole.
- THE SHARK: a colossal great white shark, many times larger than the orca, scarred grey back, white belly, rows of jagged teeth, pink gums, gigantic jaws.

LOCATION: open deep ocean, sun rays from the surface far above, a dark blue haze, a rocky reef bottom far below, drifting particles.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:02.8) — The ride. Wide side tracking shot: the orca swims left to right at speed through the deep blue, god rays above, reef rocks at the bottom, the warden a tiny figure standing on its back. By 00:01.0 a faint shark silhouette appears far in the right background; at 00:01.5 the colossal great white charges toward the orca with jaws wide open, the camera tilting up as the shark rises above them; at 00:02.5 the shark streaks past the right foreground in a heavy motion blur while the warden raises her trident.
SHOT 2 (00:02.8-00:05.8) — The stance. Low-angle shot from just behind the orca's head looking up: the warden stands tall on the orca's back near the blowhole, legs apart, trident raised high; the water churns with bubbles and swirling currents. The camera arcs around her from her left to her right side, the orca's dorsal fin sweeping into view; her white locs stream, and the trident prongs start to glow ice-blue.
SHOT 3 (00:05.8-00:06.3) — The lunge. Closer low-angle side shot: she drops into a deep forward lunge and swings the trident down and forward, prongs crackling with white-blue electricity.
SHOT 4 (00:06.3-00:10.3) — The stand-off. Side-profile medium-wide shot, near-locked with a slow push-in: the warden in a deep lunge on the orca's back in the left half of the frame, trident leveled horizontally to the right, electric arcs crackling around the prongs. MUST SHOW: the colossal great white shark emerges from the blue haze on the right, coming straight at her, its jaws opening wider and wider until by 00:09.0 the gaping mouth with rows of teeth fills the whole right half of the frame, its open mouth only a few metres from the glowing trident tips.
SHOT 5 (00:10.3-00:11.8) — The blast. MUST SHOW: the trident fires a blinding blue-white energy beam straight into the shark's open mouth: a burst of white light floods the screen, a spherical shockwave ripples through the water with lens flares and flying bubbles; the camera shakes; as the glare fades, the beam is seen striking deep inside the ring of teeth, the warden in silhouette on the orca at the lower left.
SHOT 6 (00:11.8-00:12.4) — The recoil. Wide shot: the giant shark is blown back and up into an exploding cloud of churned white water and debris, thrashing, while the warden stands on the orca in the lower left, trident pointed forward.
SHOT 7 (00:12.4-00:15.1) — The victory. Wide side shot from slightly below: the warden stands upright in silhouette on the orca's back, the orca's head and white eye patch at the lower right, trident held low and diagonal at her side; her white locs stream back in the current; behind her a massive billowing wall of churned water, bubbles and drifting debris slowly settles. Slow push-in; calm and heroic.

SOUND: deep underwater ambience and muffled pressure rumble, orca clicks and a whale call, a rising epic orchestral score with heavy drums; the shark's whoosh as it passes; electric crackling as the trident charges; a huge deep boom and shockwave roar on the blast; then the score resolves into a low triumphant swell with bubbles fizzing. No dialogue.
prompt_short: Photoreal underwater epic, 16:9: a warrior woman with white locs and pearl armor rides an orca. A colossal great white charges, jaws wide; she levels a glowing trident and blasts an energy beam into its mouth. Shockwave, god rays, triumphant final hold.
